changelog:
skill-build-wizard 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces an end-to-end, guided workflow for building production-quality agent skills in 4 sequenced stages: pre-flight checks, spec confirmation, coding acceptance, and release prep.
- Automates pre-flight workspace checks, design alignment, and code quality reviews, pausing at each stage for explicit user confirmation.
- Ensures all skills are scaffolded by skill-creator and verified via glic-check, skill-release-audit, skill-release-plus, and skill-regression before release.
- Designed for multi-step, user-facing use cases—distinct from simple scaffolding or direct publication tasks.
